entities.name: Member Enrollment Workflow
entities.description: End-to-end process for enrolling members in health plans and managing enrollment changes
entities.overview: The comprehensive business process covering how members join Clearview Health Plans, change their coverage, and handle life events that affect their enrollment. This includes both the business workflow steps and technical implementation through the Eligibility Service.
entities.details: This process encompasses multiple enrollment scenarios: new member enrollment when someone first joins a plan, open enrollment periods where existing members can change their coverage, qualifying life events (marriage, birth, job change) that allow mid-year changes, COBRA enrollment for members losing employer coverage, and retroactive enrollment changes that require claims reprocessing. The process involves both business workflow management and technical implementation through EDI 834 enrollment file processing in the Eligibility Service. Currently undocumented, causing confusion for new engineers who frequently ask about the enrollment flow.

entities.name: Qualifying Life Events Process
entities.description: Process for handling mid-year enrollment changes triggered by qualifying life events
entities.overview: The workflow that manages enrollment changes outside of open enrollment periods when members experience qualifying life events such as marriage, birth of a child, or job changes. These events create special enrollment periods allowing plan modifications.
entities.details: This process handles specific life events that qualify members for special enrollment periods: marriage (which may add dependents or change coverage needs), birth of children (requiring dependent enrollment), and job changes (which may affect eligibility or plan options). The process must validate that the life event qualifies for enrollment changes, manage timing requirements for when changes can be made, and coordinate effective dates with the triggering event dates.

entities.name: COBRA Enrollment Process
entities.description: Process for enrolling members in COBRA continuation coverage after losing employer-sponsored coverage
entities.overview: The specialized enrollment workflow that handles members who have lost employer-sponsored health coverage and are eligible for COBRA continuation benefits. This involves different rules, timelines, and premium structures than standard enrollment.
entities.details: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) enrollment is a federally mandated process that allows employees and their dependents to continue group health coverage after losing employer coverage due to job loss, reduction in hours, or other qualifying events. This process has specific legal requirements for notification timelines, coverage continuation periods, and premium payment structures. The workflow must handle the transition from employer-paid to member-paid premiums and manage the different benefit structures that may apply to COBRA coverage.

entities.name: EDI 834
entities.description: Standard electronic data interchange format for health insurance enrollment and maintenance transactions
entities.overview: The standardized EDI transaction format used to communicate member enrollment information between health plans, employers, and insurance brokers. EDI 834 files contain member demographic information, coverage details, and enrollment changes.
entities.details: EDI 834 is the Health Insurance Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance transaction standard that carries member enrollment data in a structured electronic format. These files contain member demographics (names, addresses, dates of birth), coverage effective dates, benefit plan selections, dependent information, and enrollment change indicators. The Eligibility Service processes these files as part of the technical implementation of enrollment workflows. The format includes specific segments and data elements that must be parsed and validated during processing.

entities.name: EDI 834 Processing
entities.description: Technical process for parsing and processing EDI 834 enrollment files in the Eligibility Service
entities.overview: The automated technical workflow that ingests EDI 834 enrollment files, validates their format and content, extracts member enrollment data, and updates member records and eligibility information in the system.
entities.details: This process handles the technical implementation of enrollment data processing through EDI 834 file ingestion. The workflow includes file receipt validation, EDI format parsing, business rule validation of enrollment data, member record creation or updates, and error handling for invalid or incomplete data. The process must handle batch processing of multiple enrollment records and coordinate with other systems when enrollment changes affect existing claims or benefit calculations.
